answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a staked, time-locked deposit, like basalt bedrock under a river: cheap to claim at the surface, expensive to anchor deep. A fake army must lock real capital per identity, and slashing drains the stake when an identity misbehaves. Even at the nadir of market prices the deposit floor holds, so spawning a thousand sock puppets scales the attacker's cost linearly while their upside does not.
